summary: Court-offline scored read on the shipping path (AnalyzeScreen -> prepareOriginalCaptureAnalysis -> runOriginalCaptureAnalysis) and on plain runCaptureAnalysis: connectivity-class permit failure + cached release policy + executable held grant -> on-device rating, exactly one consumeOfflineAllocation() in the commit transaction, saveOfflineAnalysis() writes local_shot (digest-bound to the receipt) with NO shot.sync outbox row, the receipt drain sends the frozen 1.0 wire entry { receipt, grant:{schemaVersion,compactJws}, output } in bounded chunks, hasShotSyncReceipt() is written only on an accepted settlement, a lost commit acknowledgement returns the durable paid read, the SHIPPING sync runtime's recovery sweep never reserves a live permit for an operation already paid offline, an owner purge removes every offline wallet row of that owner, and the Result surface names queued / presented-unanswered / HELD / REFUSED / ACCEPTED receipts truthfully.
approach: r6 (candidate 4282f5ea, a NEW commit on top of the rejected 1e9124bd; nothing amended) fixes the verify-5 reviewer + adversary findings. SCOPE: apps/mobile/src/analysis/runJournal.ts is restored byte-for-byte to the integration base 8e525d87 (mobile-analysis group not held); the recovery regression 'a recovery caller with a RAW permit port...' now drives the SHIPPING guard in syncRuntime.ts (held mobile-data group) instead. COMMENTS: the openPresentation / reconcileOfflineWallet doc comments in offlineWallet.ts are the base text again (new sentences added as separate comments), and '// Promote to the product rating; the sync transaction consumes the permit.' is back in runCaptureAnalysis.ts (re-indented inside the live-permit branch). P0 purge: OWNER_SCOPED_TABLES in repository.ts gains offline_wallet_journal, offline_receipt, offline_ticket, offline_grant, so purgeOwnerData(db, owner) (the account-deletion purge) removes the owner's whole wallet and leaves the other owner's rows untouched. P1 digest binding: sync.ts exports offlineOutputSha256(analysis) = sha256Hex(originalCanonicalJson(toOfflineOutput(analysis))); the spend (runCaptureAnalysis consume), the lost-ack replay identity check and saveOfflineAnalysis() all use it; saveOfflineAnalysis() parses the durable receipt row safely (malformed JSON -> the controlled 'does not name this analysis' error, no write), requires receipt.resultId === analysis.id AND receipt.fullOutputSha256 === offlineOutputSha256(analysis), and refuses to write local_shot otherwise (same result id with a different output is rejected). P1 Result copy: offlineCapabilities.readOfflineReceiptForResult() (owner-scoped, every candidate row goes through parseReceiptRow()) + offlineWallet.readOfflineReceiptEvidence(): accepted -> synced; refused -> refusal + server code from the applied journal; held -> server HOLD (answered) ; null settlement -> 'presented but unanswered' when an in_flight journal names the receipt, else 'queued'. ResultScreen's SyncEvidenceState gains offline_queued / offline_held{answered} / offline_refused{code}; the evidence loader checks the durable shot.sync receipt first, then the offline receipt evidence, then the outbox row; a wallet read failure falls back to the outbox state; accepted unlocks plan creation exactly like a synced shot.sync. r5 and r4 content (frozen shot.sync output shape, corrupt-payload isolation, chunked drain, guarded recovery, complete-evidence-before-in_flight) is unchanged.

baseline_failures_observed: The full DB-backed Edge suite fails 4 W04-04 live-DB tests against a Postgres built before the merged W04-04 migrations (settle_offline_receipt(jsonb,unknown,jsonb,text,boolean) does not exist); against a fresh xc_pg_up.sh database built from this head's migrations it is 1024 passed / 0 failed.
residual_risks: An offline-paid journal row stays release_pending/held on the device (it never becomes a permit-backed completion); the sweep treats it as settled work, not unfinished recovery.
Chunk size is measured on the JSON wire length (1_000_000 chars) under the Edge 2 MB body cap; a single receipt larger than the cap is still sent alone.

readOfflineReceiptForResult() pre-filters candidate rows with an owner-scoped `receipt LIKE %"<resultId>"%` JSON substring match and then confirms parseReceiptRow(row).resultId === resultId; a normalized result_id column would replace the substring pre-filter in a later schema change.
